answer: The signal report shows the merge explicitly at each inlet. Each collapsed cluster gets one marble weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. Because of that, someone who spins up 76 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 258 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1357 identities would post 2953 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
